title: Buggy mess
body: This app is an absolute mess. While the idea and web app are cool this app crashes constantly, freezes, is out of sync frequently and overall doesn‘t feel like a native iOS app at all but more like a poorly implemented web wrapper.

title: best app out there
body: this is probably the best app out there, it‘s social it‘s a task and habit manager and last but not least it‘s a game.. I sometimes have a hard time getting basic things done because there is no incentive for it.. I use this to get healthier, workout more and reduce my bad habits.. it works and it‘s really fun, highly recommended!

title: Great App, but bugged on Iphone 3G
body: It really is an amazing idea to get my life-goals in an RPG game, i always thought this would be one of the best ideas ever! I am now part of the web-version and enjoy it a lot. The only problem is: The App shuts itself down every time i open it. (on my iphone 3g) I really hope that you can fix that, then you'll get five stars from me!
